Part VII. Investments and Trusts, Line 3, is a heading. Lines 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 are the individual funds contained in the Wisconsin Deferred Compensation

Program, which is maintained and controlled by a former state government employer (Wisconsin) and appears to fall under the instruction on page 47 of the filing

instructions. Although the instructions indicate that the individual funds need not be listed, I had initially listed the funds and was advised by the Committee in

2006 to continue listing the funds rather than remove them.

* Note from Part V

On my original 2005 report, the box next to “Gifts”, part IV, was inadvertently left not checked. I have corrected the omission on the amended report, and the

“None” box is now checked.

* Note from Part VII

You also inquired about the circumstances surrounding the deletion of the Janus Fund investment and its replacement with the Vangard Admiral Treasury Money

Market. These are funds into which my deferred compensation contributions from when I was employed by the State of Wisconsin were directed. They are held

in trust and managed by the Wisconsin Department of Employee Trust Funds. The change resulted from a decision by the fund to discontinue the Janus Fund. My

contributions to that fund were transferred to the Vangard Admiral Treasury Money Market by the fund.
